name: Head
overview: Scripture uses the head as a significant symbol of both physical and spiritual conditions. The leprous affliction on the bald head described in Leviticus 13 reveals the seriousness of internal disease and uncleanness, while the anointing of the head with oil in Leviticus 14 signifies divine cleansing and atonement before the LORD. Isaiah 3:17 further illustrates God's judgment through the striking of the crown of the head, indicating heavy consequences for sin. Together, these passages emphasize the head's role in representing purity, judgment, and the need for God's sanctifying intervention.
